notes: Stable patch: WordPress View version details now opens native Description, Installation and Changelog sections. Greek release notes are read from the latest authenticated signed ZIP, including versions 1.2.1, 1.2.0, 1.1.1 and 1.1.0. Signature/expiry/archive checks precede cached notes; readme HTML is escaped and compatibility version metadata is validated. Existing approval modes, permissions and connections are unchanged. This first client update is required to enable the previously missing information hook; later releases can then be reviewed before installation. All 12 final-source CI jobs passed, with 14 native WordPress suites in every supported matrix job.
